title: How China Is Aiding Kazakh Efforts to Become Hyper Modern
author: Albert Otkjær
text:
Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev speaks at the opening of the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai, China, July 17, 2026..
Credit: Facebook/Akorda
On July 17, Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev concluded a trip to Shanghai, China, by speaking at the opening of the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference. While restating Kazakhstan’s efforts to become a regional hub for digital trade and international cooperation, Tokayev also praised China for its advancements in the field during his 16-minute speech.The day before, the Kazakh president had already expressed his desire to deepen cooperation between the two countries in the field of technology. This was underscored by the signing of deals worth more than $15 billion covering digital infrastructure, transport, and the security sector.[...]
